answer: Mechanism: operator clawback ledger. Wallets post nothing; each registering operator must prefund a reserve. A sonnet-style audit samples behavioral fingerprints. When a gale of duplicate patterns links identities, the rule debits that operator's reserve per linked identity and freezes its registration key. A lotus mark records the clawback. Attacker cost per identity: the reserve plus three times registration fee, borne by the operator; wallet stays untouched.
